name: PEMS-BAY PEMS03
description: A traffic-flow forecasting dataset containing measurements from 358 sensors in the San Francisco Bay Area, sampled at 5-minute intervals. PEMS03 denotes the first three months of the PEMS-BAY collection.
citation: Li, Y., Yu, R., Shahabi, C., & Liu, Y. (2018). Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2018). https://openreview.net/forum?id=SJiHXGWAZ
